mes , supporting European strategic autonomy and security, while advancing defence and space capability development through innovative technologies, industrial competitiveness, and cross - sector synergies . EU competences and obligations for defence in dustry action are conferred under the TFEU Title XVII Industry, in particular Article 173(3), and Title XIX Research and development, in particular Article 182(4), Article 183 and the second paragraph of Article 188; and for space under Articles 189 and 4( 3) TFEU. The policy domains of the defence industry and space fall under shared competence with Member States , bordering areas where Member States have exclusive competences, such as security and defence. Under the leadership of European Commissioner for D efence and Space, Andrius Kubilius , DG DEFIS collaborates closely with Member States and key stakeholders to strengthen the EU's defence and space capa bilities . In the context of Russia’s war on Ukraine and shifting geopolitical dynamics, DG DEFIS ’s missio n is increasingly vital for achieving EU objectives.
